translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.56:1: When the Inevitable Event takes place
verses.56:2: then no one can deny it has come
verses.56:4: When the earth will be violently shaken
verses.56:5: and the mountains will be crushed to pieces
verses.56:7: you will ˹all˺ be ˹divided into˺ three groups
verses.56:8: the people of the right, how ˹blessed˺ will they be
verses.56:9: the people of the left, how ˹miserable˺ will they be
verses.56:10: and the foremost ˹in faith˺ will be the foremost ˹in Paradise˺
verses.56:11: They are the ones nearest ˹to Allah˺
verses.56:13: ˹They will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations
verses.56:14: and a few from later generations
verses.56:17: They will be waited on by eternal youths
verses.56:18: with cups, pitchers, and a drink ˹of pure wine˺ from a flowing stream
verses.56:19: that will cause them neither headache nor intoxication
verses.56:20: ˹They will also be served˺ any fruit they choose
verses.56:21: and meat from any bird they desire
verses.56:22: And ˹they will have˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes
verses.56:24: ˹all˺ as a reward for what they used to do
verses.56:25: There they will never hear any idle or sinful talk—
verses.56:27: And the people of the right—how ˹blessed˺ will they be
verses.56:28: ˹They will be˺ amid thornless lote trees
verses.56:33: never out of season nor forbidden—
verses.56:35: Indeed, We will have perfectly created their mates
verses.56:38: for the people of the right
verses.56:39: ˹who will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations
verses.56:40: and a multitude from later generations
verses.56:41: And the people of the left—how ˹miserable˺ will they be
verses.56:42: ˹They will be˺ in scorching heat and boiling water
verses.56:43: in the shade of black smoke
verses.56:45: Indeed, before this ˹torment˺ they were spoiled by luxury
verses.56:46: and persisted in the worst of sin
verses.56:47: They used to ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
verses.56:49: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Most certainly, earlier and later generations
verses.56:50: will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day
verses.56:52: will certainly eat from ˹the fruit of˺ the trees of Zaqqûm
verses.56:54: Then on top of that you will drink boiling water—
verses.56:55: and you will drink ˹it˺ like thirsty camels do.”
verses.56:56: This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment
verses.56:57: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺
verses.56:58: Have you considered what you ejaculate
verses.56:59: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so
verses.56:60: We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you, and We cannot be prevented
verses.56:61: from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you
verses.56:62: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful
verses.56:63: Have you considered what you sow
verses.56:64: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who do so
verses.56:65: If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament
verses.56:67: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”
verses.56:68: Have you considered the water you drink
verses.56:69: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who do so
verses.56:70: If We willed, We could make it salty. Will you not then give thanks
verses.56:71: Have you considered the fire you kindle
verses.56:72: Is it you who produce its trees, or is it We Who do so
verses.56:73: We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers
verses.56:74: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
verses.56:75: So I do swear by the positions of the stars—
verses.56:76: and this, if only you knew, is indeed a great oath—
verses.56:77: that this is truly a noble Quran
verses.56:79: touched by none except the purified ˹angels˺
verses.56:80: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
verses.56:81: How can you then take this message lightly
verses.56:82: and repay ˹Allah for˺ your provisions with denial
verses.56:83: Why then ˹are you helpless˺ when the soul ˹of a dying person˺ reaches ˹their˺ throat
verses.56:85: And We are nearer to such a person than you, but you cannot see
verses.56:86: Now, if you are not subject to Our Will ˹as you claim˺
verses.56:87: bring that soul back, if what you say is true
verses.56:88: So, if the deceased is one of those brought near ˹to Us˺
verses.56:89: then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss
verses.56:90: And if the deceased is one of the people of the right
verses.56:91: then ˹they will be told,˺ “Greetings to you from the people of the right.”
verses.56:92: But if such person is one of the misguided deniers
verses.56:93: then their accommodation will be boiling water ˹to drink˺
verses.56:95: Indeed, this is the absolute truth
verses.56:96: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
